Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A live voice or text conversation session with the AI companion.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this conversation.

title.description: The generated title of the conversation.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the conversation was started.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last message in this conversation.

durationSeconds.description: Total duration of the voice session in seconds.

summary.description: A brief AI-generated summary of the conversation.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: An individual message within a conversation.

role.description: Whether the message was sent by the user or the model.

text.description: The textual content or transcript of the utterance.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the message was sent or received.

Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: A persistent memory or preference retained across conversations.

userId.description: The UID of the user this memory belongs to.

content.description: The factual content of the memory.

category.description: The category of memory for organizing context.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when this memory was stored.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User specific custom preferences for the AI companion.

userId.description: The UID of the user these settings belong to.

preferredName.description: The name the user prefers to be called.

personality.description: The personality style of the companion.

humor.description: How humorous or sarcastic the companion should be.

memoryEnabled.description: Whether the companion should learn and use memories.

SourceDoc.title: SourceDoc
SourceDoc.description: A document or text block ingested for knowledge grounding.

userId.description: The UID of the user this document belongs to.

name.description: The filename or title of the document.

type.description: The MIME type of the content.

content.description: The full text content of the document.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Subcollection of messages inside a conversation.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Top-level collection for persistent long-term memories.

/settings/{userId}.description: User-specific configuration document indexed by user UID.

/knowledge/{docId}.description: Top-level collection for ingested knowledge materials.
